title: Amazon’s 2026 Top 100+ Toys list: Something for every kid at heart
summary: From budget-friendly finds and Amazon exclusives to trending collectibles, sensory toys, and screen-free favorites, the annual list for 2026 spotlights 100+ expert-curated toys to make holiday gifting easier.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Amazon's 2026 Top 100+ Toys list features trending toys across categories, from budget-friendly picks and screen-free products to collectibles, sensory toys, entertainment and character favorites, and Amazon exclusives.


- The list is organized into shoppable themes, making it easy to find the right toy for every age and interest on your holiday list.


- This year's list features toys from popular franchises like Marvel, PAW Patrol, and Pokémon, along with Amazon exclusives from FAO Schwarz (a new brand on Amazon), American Girl, and special editions of popular toys like the Little Tikes Cozy Coupe car.


---


Amazon is giving parents and gift givers a head start on holiday shopping with the release of our 2026 Top 100+ Toys list. Curated by a team of Amazon toy experts, the annual list brings together the top trending toys of the season—from beloved brands and emerging favorites to budget-friendly finds and exclusive Amazon products.


Organized into shoppable themes, the list makes it easy to discover toys based on interests, ages, and favorite ways to play. From collectors and makers to sensory seekers and superfans, there’s something for everyone.
